l.i: id juris sibi vendicat. Neque enim existimo
Episcopatum, ut habetur in Anglia de jure humano, esse
divertat ad Papam, aut in eo,
sed in Rege gradum sistat quem
Anglia, ut me docuit non ita

page.notes: Catchword "mus" is the printed word at the foot; the footnote mark "*" and figure "2" are printed at the foot. Several words in the italic text are set in a slightly broken or blurred type and were read with some doubt, e.g. "molitur", "sistat", "agnoscit". The word "ut" in "ut habetur" and "futurum" were read with care.
